newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian GIMV invests in transformer firm Pauwels.
newsitem.headline: Belgian GIMV invests in transformer firm Pauwels.

text.p: GIMV, the investment company of the Flemish regional government, will inject 700 million francs in a two billion investment programme of Belgian transformer manufacturer Pauwels Group, Pauwels said on Wednesday.
The 1996-2000 programme aims to lift the group's turnover to 12 billion francs by 2000 and strengthen its profitability.
Mechelen-based Pauwels, which has a total workforce of 2,200 worldwide, said the 700 million francs from GIMV would help lay the foundations for further expansion.

Pauwels noted that although sales were spread over about 100 countries, it was mainly eyeing further market penetration in East Europe, China and South America through potential takeover opportunities or joint ventures.

GIMV will underwrite the capital increases at Pauwels International NV and Pauwels Contracting NV for a total amount of 400 million francs, and also subscribe to a convertible subordinated loan issued by both companies which would allow capital to rise by a further 300 million.
Pauwels' board will be enlarged with two members from GIMV.
Pauwels said GIMV's investment in it reflected its policy of taking stakes in Flemish companies to give them the necessary financial muscle and stamina to continue international expansion.
